text: {"lessons":["A few months of account changes are not enough to justify reacting to every market move; I should make decisions based on a clear plan, not short-term fluctuations.","I should not let my average cost dictate whether I hold or sell; I should assess each stock’s prospects and its role in my portfolio from today onward.","Before selling several holdings and buying more of another, I should check that the trades fit my diversification, cash needs, and long-term apartment goal."]}
